summary: stdcall: parses a track surface material token into a float. Reads a string token via sub_565520(a2, buffer, 0). If the token begins with a digit (48-57) or '.' (46) it is parsed directly as a float via sub_58850F. Otherwise it walks a linked list headed by a4 (next pointer at +36), compares names with strcmp and returns the float value at +32 on match. On no match (or null list head) it runs an error split/debug log path and returns 0.

operations.description: Call sub_565520(a2, v7, 0) to read the token string into the 128-byte buffer v7; store the status in v4.
When v4 is zero (token read failed) return v4 (0) immediately.
When the first token byte v7[0] is in [48,57] (digit) or equals 46 ('.') treat the token as a numeric literal.
Convert the numeric token to float via sub_58850F(v7), store the result in *a3 and return v4.
Walk the linked list starting at a4: compare v7 with the entry name via strcmp; on mismatch follow the next pointer at entry+36; stop when a null next pointer is found.
On a strcmp match, store the entry's float value at entry+32 into *a3 and return v4.
On lookup failure, call StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_25, 2231) and, if it returns non-zero, write a debug message via DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aCouldNotFindTr).
Return 0 on the failure path (or when no matching list entry exists).
Called by TrackSurfaceMaterialLoader (0x004CDD80) to resolve a surface token to its numeric value.
